title: Needs improvments
body:
If I set that week starts at monday, app must count my habits from monday to sunday! Now it’s counting from sunday even if it’s set that week starts on monday.

If I set that I need to do something 5 times a week, those two days that i skip dont’t conut as not done or bad day. It is OK to skip those two days, but if I skip more than that, then count it as a bad day.

App needs better design.
author: Taurus RA
